$comment: The fork's pin, in one machine-readable place. Prose (chromium/README.md, TASKS.md, P0_SPIKE_RUNBOOK.md) records the version we built, but nothing could read it. `npm run upstream:check` (app/scripts/upstream-check.mjs) reads this file. After every rebase, set `base` to the checkout's chrome/VERSION and `branch` to the new working branch — the check is only as honest as this number.
$patches_comment: Applied in order: branding.diff first (it is a commit on the branch, not a working-tree edit), then upstream-edits.diff. newFileTrees are copied into the checkout as-is — they are new files, so a diff would be pure addition. chrome/browser/resources/webdeck is deliberately absent: it is build output, regenerated by `npm run pack:webui`. Together these three reproduce the fork from a pristine base; nothing else in the checkout is ours.
